pages.text: Altered from $(5)Unbreaking$(), $(4)Relocation$() has a level based chance to move any durability damage the equipment would take onto another worn or hand-equipped gear. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Unbreaking$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It enables the use of Gold tools or anything that has low durability, since the relocation will always happen when used with the maximum level. It's important to note that it will fail if the targeted gear also has Relocation.
